alyosha.conditionEn: nearby party member triggers an Electro-related reaction
alyosha.conditionZh: 队伍中附近的角色触发雷元素相关反应
alyosha.note: Party-wide reaction trigger with no Alyosha-side action; bound to E because Alyosha casts E (15s CD) at least once per rotation, and the 18s ICD allows roughly one proc per rotation.
